subject: general
question: Which one of the following continents has the highest number of countries ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Africa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Africa**__ is the world's** second-largest continent **after Asia.
 
• A large part of the African continent lies in the **Northern Hemisphere.**
 
• It is the** ****second-most populous continent i**n the world.
 
• Africa has the **highest number of countries** among continents.
 __
 
• Africa comprises **54 countries.**
 
 
 
• Africa is surrounded by:
 
 
• The Mediterranean Sea in the north.
 
• The Atlantic Ocean in the west.
 
• The Indian Ocean in the southeast.
 
• The Suez Canal, the Red Sea and the Arabian Sea in the northeast.
 
 
 
• Africa is located between the** latitudes 37° North and 35° South and between the longitudes 50° East and 20° West.**
 
• The **Equator** runs almost through the middle of the continent.
 
• Africa is the only continent through which the T**ropic of Cancer, the Equator and the Tropic of Capricorn pass.**
 
• The world’s largest hot desert **Sahara desert** is located in Africa.
 
• The world’s longest river the** Nile** flows through Africa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asia** is the world's largest continent.

 
 
• Asia comprises **49 countries. **
 
 
 
• **Europe** is the continent that lies to the west of Asia.
 
 
• Europe comprises** 44 countries.**
 
 
 
• **North America** is the third largest continent in the world.
 
 
• North America comprises** 23 countries.**
